name: hours-statement
title: Statement of volunteer hours
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || first_name || ' ' || last_name as name from volunteers where status in ('active', 'inactive', 'former') and exists (select 1 from hours h where h.volunteer_id = volunteers.id and h.approved_on is not null) order by ref

sections.title: The volunteer
sections.sql: select v.first_name || ' ' || v.last_name as volunteer, v.ref, to_char(v.started_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as volunteering_since, s.org_name as organisation from volunteers v cross join settings s where v.id = $1

sections.title: Hours by program, the last twelve months
sections.sql: select p.name as program, string_agg(distinct coalesce(r.name, h.activity), ', ') as roles, count(*) as entries, round(sum(h.minutes) / 60.0, 1) as hours from hours h join programs p on p.id = h.program_id left join roles r on r.id = h.role_id where h.volunteer_id = $1 and h.approved_on is not null and h.worked_on >= current_date - 365 group by p.name order by 4 desc

sections.title: All time
sections.sql: select round(sum(minutes) / 60.0, 1) as total_hours, to_char(min(worked_on), 'DD Month YYYY') as first_recorded, to_char(max(worked_on), 'DD Month YYYY') as most_recent from hours where volunteer_id = $1 and approved_on is not null

name: funder-report
title: Volunteer contribution report
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || name as name from programs where status = 'active' order by ref

sections.title: The program
sections.sql: select p.name as program, coalesce(p.funder, 'not recorded') as funder, st.name as coordinator, (select org_name from settings) as organisation from programs p left join staff st on st.id = p.coordinator_id where p.id = $1

sections.title: This financial year to date
sections.sql: select count(distinct h.volunteer_id) as volunteers, count(*) as entries, round(sum(h.minutes) / 60.0, 1) as hours from hours h cross join settings s where h.program_id = $1 and h.approved_on is not null and h.worked_on >= make_date(extract(year from current_date)::int - case when extract(month from current_date) < s.fy_start_month then 1 else 0 end, s.fy_start_month, 1)

sections.title: By month
sections.sql: select to_char(period, 'Mon YYYY') as month, volunteers, round(minutes / 60.0, 1) as hours from v_program_hours where program_id = $1 and period >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '11 months' order by period

sections.title: Roles
sections.sql: select r.name as role, count(distinct h.volunteer_id) as volunteers, round(coalesce(sum(h.minutes), 0) / 60.0, 1) as hours_last_12_months from roles r left join hours h on h.role_id = r.id and h.approved_on is not null and h.worked_on >= current_date - 365 where r.program_id = $1 group by r.name order by 3 desc

name: screening-record
title: Volunteer screening record
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || first_name || ' ' || last_name as name from volunteers where status in ('active', 'applicant') order by ref

sections.title: The volunteer
sections.sql: select ref, first_name || ' ' || last_name as volunteer, status, stage, to_char(applied_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as applied, to_char(interviewed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as interviewed, to_char(references_ok_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as references_checked, coalesce(guardian_name || ' on ' || to_char(guardian_consent_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as guardian_consent from volunteers where id = $1

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select check_name(c.kind, c.jurisdiction) as check_held, c.number, to_char(c.issued_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as issued, to_char(c.good_until, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as good_until, to_char(c.verified_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as verified, coalesce(st.name, '') as verified_by, c.state from v_checks c left join checks x on x.id = c.id left join staff st on st.id = x.verified_by where c.volunteer_id = $1 order by c.kind

sections.title: Training
sections.sql: select course, to_char(completed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as completed, coalesce(to_char(expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as expires, state from v_training where volunteer_id = $1 order by course

name: recognition-certificate
title: Thank you
for_each: select r.id, v.first_name || ' ' || v.last_name || ' ' || r.milestone as name from recognitions r join volunteers v on v.id = r.volunteer_id where r.awarded_on >= current_date - 60 order by r.awarded_on desc

sections.title: In recognition of
sections.sql: select v.first_name || ' ' || v.last_name as volunteer, r.milestone, to_char(r.awarded_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as awarded, s.org_name as from_organisation from recognitions r join volunteers v on v.id = r.volunteer_id cross join settings s where r.id = $1
